Metadata.title: Thoth — Many bookstores, one cart
Metadata.description: Thoth is a book marketplace of verified bookstores. Order from many stores in a single cart.

Footer.tagline: A book marketplace of verified bookstores. One cart, a separate order for each store.

Banner.headline: Many bookstores. One cart.
Banner.lead: Every bookstore on Thoth is verified before it can sell. Order from many stores and get a separate order from each one.
Banner.caption: Illustrative stores. The “Verified” mark appears only after Thoth approves a seller’s application.

SignUp.title: Create an account
SignUp.description: One account to buy from every bookstore on Thoth.
SignUp.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
SignUp.dateOfBirthHint: You must be at least {minAge} to create an account.
SignUp.terms: I agree to Thoth’s <terms>Terms of use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

Validation.emailInvalid: That email isn’t valid. Example: name@example.com
Validation.fullNameMin: Full name needs at least 2 characters.
Validation.fullNameMax: Full name can be at most 100 characters.
Validation.passwordMax: Password can be at most 128 characters.
Validation.passwordLetter: Password needs at least one letter.
Validation.passwordDigit: Password needs at least one number.
Validation.dateOfBirthRequired: Please pick your date of birth.
Validation.dateOfBirthFuture: Date of birth can’t be in the future.
Validation.minAge: You must be at least {minAge} to create an account.
Validation.termsRequired: You need to accept the terms to continue.
Validation.slugFormat: Lowercase letters and numbers, words joined by single hyphens. Example: nha-sach-an
Validation.phoneFormat: Enter 9–15 digits, optionally starting with +. Example: +84901234567
Validation.dateFuture: This date can’t be in the future.
Validation.idNumberFormat: The citizen ID number has exactly 12 digits.
Validation.taxCodeFormat: 10 digits, or 10 digits + “-” + 3 digits for a branch.

Errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

VerifyEmail.successBody: Your Thoth account is ready. You can now buy from every verified bookstore.
VerifyEmail.invalidHint: Each link works once and expires. If you received several emails, open the newest one from Thoth.
VerifyEmail.missingToken: This verification link is missing its code. Open the full link from the email again.
VerifyEmail.resendSent: A new email is on its way. Check your inbox, and your spam folder too.
VerifyEmail.resendSentMaybe: If this email belongs to an unverified account, we’ve sent a new link. Check your inbox, and your spam folder too.

CheckEmail.signedUpDescription: Your account is created. We just sent a verification link to:
CheckEmail.signedUpHint: Open the email and press “Verify email” to activate your account. The link works for 24 hours. Can’t find it? Check your spam folder.
CheckEmail.unverifiedTitle: Verify your email to sign in
CheckEmail.unverifiedDescription: This account isn’t verified yet. We just sent a new verification link to:
CheckEmail.unverifiedHint: Open the email, press “Verify email”, then come back and sign in. The link works for 24 hours. Can’t find it? Check your spam folder.

Home.lead: Find books from many verified bookstores and check out in one cart.
Home.sampleNote: The books and bookstores below are sample data, not real listings.
Home.storesLead: A bookstore wears Thoth’s postmark only after its seller application is approved.
Home.sellLead: Put your whole shelf on one shared marketplace. Buyers order from many stores; you get your own orders.

register.title: Register your store
register.body: Store name, address and contact details.

kyc.title: Submit verification
kyc.body: Documents Thoth uses to verify the seller.

review.title: Get approved, start selling
review.body: Once approved, your store goes live.

Sell.title: Sell on Thoth
Sell.lead: Open your store, verify who you are, and once Thoth approves you, your books reach readers across the country.

shop.title: Register your store
shop.lead: This is what buyers see. You can change it later.

kyc.title: Verify {shop}
kyc.lead: Thoth checks every seller before their store goes live. Save a draft any time and come back later. Documents are stored privately and only reviewers can see them.

pending.title: {shop} is under review
pending.lead: We’ll check your documents and let you know. You can’t edit them while the review is open.

approved.title: {shop} is verified
approved.lead: Your store is live. Buyers can now find it on Thoth.

editShop.title: Store details
editShop.lead: Changes are saved right away and don’t affect your verification.

slug.label: Store address
slug.hint: Your store’s link: thoth.vn/shops/your-address. Lowercase, numbers and hyphens.

description.label: Description (optional)
description.hint: What you sell, in a sentence or two.

pickupAddress.label: Pickup address
pickupAddress.hint: Where couriers collect orders. Not shown to buyers.

Kyc.identityLead: As printed on your citizen ID card (CCCD).

docHints.ID_FRONT: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. All four corners visible.
docHints.ID_BACK: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB.
docHints.SELFIE: Hold the card next to your face. JPEG or PNG.
docHints.BUSINESS_LICENSE: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB.

Kyc.bankCodeHint: Short name, e.g. VCB, TCB, BIDV.
Kyc.accountHolderHint: Must match your legal name or business name, as the bank prints it.

upload.wrongType: This file type isn’t accepted here.
